summary: Optional UI layer for the Interaction System gem: an on-screen interaction prompt built with LyShine that shows the key hint and the action labels (press / hold) of the interactable the player is looking at.
requirements: Requires the InteractionSystem, LyShine, LocalizationContract and InputHintsContract gems (enabled automatically through dependencies). Labels are translated only when a gem implementing LocalizationContract (e.g. LocalizationGem) is enabled, otherwise their default texts are shown. The key hint shows the bound key only when a gem implementing InputHintsContract (e.g. RebindableInput) is enabled, otherwise the text set in the canvas is shown.
